question: What is the exact current text of the 2017 Trust Services Criteria (revised points of focus 2022) and DC 200 description criteria, and do the REQ-TSC/REQ-SOCDC own-words summaries match them?
why_unresolvable_internally: The AICPA documents need a free AICPA account login; agents in this program do not create accounts, so the primary text was not read.
lowest_cost_resolution: Owner (or delegate) creates a free AICPA account, downloads both PDFs to a restricted store and a reviewer checks each REQ-TSC/REQ-SOCDC row (about 1-2 hours).

question: For the first sponsor, what is the external auditor's planned approach to Unbound as a service organization: rely on a SOC 1 Type 2, test controls directly at Unbound, or take a substantive-only approach?
why_unresolvable_internally: Only the sponsor's auditor decides its audit strategy (AU-C 402); it depends on that auditor's risk assessment and the sponsor's materiality.
lowest_cost_resolution: Through the sponsor, ask its audit engagement partner for a short written planned-approach statement before build commitment (already required by Unbound SPD-PLT-001).
blocks: SOC 1 timing and scope; Unbound release-1 assurance plan

question: Which legal entity is the 'service organization' for Unbound: a separate Unbound operator, Echelon Foundry, or the sponsor itself in a self-operated model? Are Echelon shared systems (Folio, Praxis, etc.) subservice organizations or part of the system?
why_unresolvable_internally: This is a corporate-structure and contracting decision not yet made; it fixes whose management signs the assertion and which controls are in scope.
lowest_cost_resolution: Owner decision recorded as a DF-ASR decision record, then confirmed with a CPA firm during readiness scoping.
blocks: System boundary; management assertion; carve-out vs inclusive for EF systems

question: Beyond Security, which trust services categories (Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity) should be in Unbound's first SOC 2, given its service commitments?
why_unresolvable_internally: Category selection depends on contractual service commitments not yet written and on CPA scoping judgment.
lowest_cost_resolution: Draft service commitments in the sponsor contract template, then do a 1-hour scoping call with two candidate CPA firms.

question: Does Unbound make privacy commitments to data subjects in its own right (e.g. direct donor collection in white-label programs), or only as the sponsor's processor? Should the Privacy category be in scope?
why_unresolvable_internally: This needs legal characterisation of data roles per deployment model, plus CPA judgment on criterion relevance.
lowest_cost_resolution: Counsel memo on data roles per operating model (can be combined with existing privacy work), then CPA scoping.

question: Will financial-institution partners require SOC 1, SOC 2 or both, and with what period, bridge-letter and right-to-audit terms? Will the 2026 proposed interagency TPRM guidance change this when final?
why_unresolvable_internally: Bank TPRM requirements are set in each bank's policy and contract; the 2026 guidance is not final.
lowest_cost_resolution: Ask the first prospective bank partner's TPRM team for its standard vendor assurance requirements list; monitor final interagency guidance.

question: For SOC 1 scoping, are the custodians, banks and payment processors that Unbound interacts with subservice organizations (carve-out with CSOCs), the sponsor's own service organizations, or outside AU-C 402 because they process sponsor-authorised transactions (AU-C 402.05)?
why_unresolvable_internally: Applying AU-C 402.05 and the AT-C 320 subservice definition to specific contracts and flows needs CPA judgment.
lowest_cost_resolution: Present the FundsFlow declaration and contract map to the candidate service auditor during readiness; record the conclusion per counterparty.

question: What will the final 2027 TSC and description criteria contain (criterion count, COSO alignment, AI points of focus), and when will they take effect? Should Unbound's first SOC 2 adopt them early?
why_unresolvable_internally: The exposure drafts are open for comment until 2027-01-15 and are login-gated; the final version is not issued.
lowest_cost_resolution: Monitor the AICPA SOC page after Jan 2027 (internal research); read the final criteria once issued (needs the OQ-100 account).

question: Will the selected service auditor accept automated, continuously collected evidence (Folio packages, system-generated populations) as IPE, and on what basis will it test completeness and accuracy (e.g. testing controls over evidence generation versus independent extraction)?
why_unresolvable_internally: Acceptance is the auditor's professional judgment under AT-C 205.36 / 320.30 and its firm methodology; 2026 peer-review scrutiny of platform reliance makes firms cautious.
lowest_cost_resolution: Walk a candidate firm through a synthetic Folio evidence package and ask for written feedback on IPE testing approach during readiness.
blocks: Evidence architecture design; audit cost model

question: Can any Echelon monitoring function (human or agent) qualify as an 'internal audit function' whose work a service auditor may use (AT-C 205.40), and would agent-performed monitoring support management's reasonable basis for its assertion?
why_unresolvable_internally: Objectivity and competence are evaluated by the service auditor; there is no precedent we can cite for agent-performed internal audit.
lowest_cost_resolution: Ask a candidate CPA firm during readiness; meanwhile design monitoring as a management control (CC4), not as internal audit.

question: What first Type 2 period length and end date would the first sponsor's auditor and any bank partner accept, given the sponsor fiscal year (AU-C 402.A34 overlap)?
why_unresolvable_internally: Depends on the user auditor's judgment and fiscal-year calendars that are not known.
lowest_cost_resolution: Include in the OQ-101 planned-approach request.

question: Can one CPA firm perform SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 over the same period on a shared control set, and at what cost range?
why_unresolvable_internally: Fee and staffing data are firm-specific and not public.
lowest_cost_resolution: Request indicative proposals from 2-3 licensed, peer-reviewed firms once the scope (OQ-102/103) is drafted.

question: Is a SOC 3 or a SOC 2 Type 1 worth obtaining for sponsor and partner sales before the first Type 2 completes?
why_unresolvable_internally: This is a commercial judgment needing buyer feedback.
lowest_cost_resolution: Ask prospective sponsors and partners in discovery calls whether a Type 1 or SOC 3 would unblock procurement.

question: How will the proposed 2027 AI points of focus apply to Unbound's agents (model monitoring, prompt manipulation, automated decisions), and what must the system description disclose about AI without exposing vulnerabilities?
why_unresolvable_internally: The final text is not issued, and its application to agentic operations is untested in practice.
lowest_cost_resolution: Re-review after the final 2027 TSC issue; seek service-auditor views during readiness.

question: Beyond Unbound, does Echelon Foundry itself provide services to other user entities (e.g. hosted Echelon systems) that would warrant its own SOC 2?
why_unresolvable_internally: This depends on EF's business model and customer contracts, which are owner decisions.
lowest_cost_resolution: Owner states which EF services are or will be offered externally.

question: Do target DAF sponsors have audited financial statements (GAAS AU-C or other standards, e.g. Uniform Guidance), and how material are DAF balances and transactions to them?
why_unresolvable_internally: Depends on specific sponsors and state requirements not researched in this batch.
lowest_cost_resolution: Ask first sponsor prospects for their audit firm and audit standard; cross-check daf-landscape research on state audit thresholds.

question: Should SOC 1 control objectives for DAF administration be specified by management alone, or aligned with sponsor auditors or an industry group? No industry-specified objectives for DAF administration were found.
why_unresolvable_internally: No published DAF-specific control-objective set was found; alignment requires auditor input.
lowest_cost_resolution: Draft control objectives from UNB-ACC/CNV-FIN requirements and review with the OQ-101 auditor and a candidate service auditor.
